newsitem.title: USA: Westchester Cty, N.Y., $59.5M GOs AAA - Fitch.
newsitem.headline: Westchester Cty, N.Y., $59.5M GOs AAA - Fitch.

text.p: Westchester County (NY.)'s $59,505,000 general obligation 1996 serial bonds are rated 'AAA' by Fitch Investors Service.

The bonds are scheduled to be sold competitively Nov. 14, 1996 and mature serially Nov. 15, 1997-2016. Bonds maturing on or after Nov. 15, 2007 are callable at 101%, declining thereafter. Westchester County continues to possess the highest quality credit. Financial performance remains sound, with adequate balances maintained.

Operations for 1996 are reported to be within budget, with newly privatized functions performing consistent with financial expectations. The county executive's proposed operating budget for 1997 will be presented to the county legislature next week. The 1993 establishment of the Westchester County Medical Center as an enterprise fund has resulted in improved financial operations. Performance in both 1994 and 1995 was within budget and similar results are projected for 1996 operations. County debt levels remain easily manageable, as does the capital program. Infrastructure generally is in place. Economic growth and development, particularly in the retail sector, continues. Assessed valuation has stabilized.
